violation_type.title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §747.4303(b))
violation_type.short_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name
violation_type.typical_finding: Napping mats / cribs are not individually assigned and labeled with the children's names / assigned number. Mats are not marked or colored so that the sleeping side can be distinguished from the floor side.

finding_variants.text: Napping mats / cribs are not individually assigned and labeled with the children's names / assigned number. Mats are not marked or colored so that the sleeping side can be distinguished from the floor side.
Mats used during naptime were not numbered or labeled.

Children's mats being used by children during naptime, were not labeled.    This was corrected at inspection when the primary caregiver labeled them with numbers that were assigned to each child in care on a posted chart.
The cots were not labeled with child's name or number/child assigemen map was not available. This was corrected during the inspection when the provider placed labels on the cots.
One child's mat was not labeled with child's name. (photos taken).    This was corrected at inspection after the mat was labeled with child's name. Photo taken.
